data.title: bn-38q: M0.1.1 Build the stack tools and record installed versus checkout identity
data.description: Tech-lead review of the inventory snapshot, regeneration/build scripts, project-local tool activation, and acceptance evidence.

data.reason: The checked-in inventory identifies the three project-local executables with absolute paths under the ephemeral bn-38q workspace. The required merge destroys that workspace, so the inventory would immediately point at nonexistent binaries and the tools would no longer be runnable for the default project. Emit a durable project-relative path (with an explicit path kind/base) for .stack-target tools, assert the snapshot contains no .maw/workspaces path, regenerate, and then retarget this same review.

LGTM after re-review. The inventory now preserves executable identity while using durable project-root-relative locations for local stack binaries; checks cover schema shape, uniqueness, ephemeral-path exclusion, and local path semantics. `just check` and diff checks pass.
